input: One UTF-8 JSON object followed by newline, maximum65536bytes including terminator, sent only through the existing interactive tool session.
actualToolSessionId: Record the real ID in a separate coordination receipt before sending credentials; never infer it from an OS PID.
liveReceipt: Fresh path outside checkout; parent directory must already exist. Root may copy a terminal receipt into repository evidence after command completion.

credentialObject.source: fresh credential returned for the same project, never copied into this document or any receipt
credentialObject.branch: main for both checkpoint helpers; use returned authorized branch for official Sites
credentialObject.token: required only for http_extra_header; hidden stdin only, never argv/file/persistent environment
credentialObject.remote_url: exact returned authorized project repository HTTPS URL

jsonOptional.fetchOnly: boolean; true only fetches and verifies

jsonOptional.transportCommits: ordered unique array of1..20 exact40hex commits, final item expectedCommit; omission means[HEAD]

bounded-checkpoints.expectedRemoteCommit: exact40hex current checkpoint branch HEAD, must match fresh remote observation
bounded-checkpoints.volumeBound: maximum32000000 raw new object bytes per transport step; time separately bounded by wrapper

sourceObject.checkout_path: absolute checkout equal to wrapper --checkout or its default

jsonForPublicationPreparation.commands: zero or more explicitly intended preparation argv arrays inside JSON; at most20 arrays, at most64 strings each; no arbitrary command-line argv accepted by wrapper

sites-workflow.stageAuthorization: Root invokes publication preparation only after the actual cost gate and other required publication gates pass. This generic transport wrapper does not assert those gates.
sites-workflow.effect: Official helper prepares/saves source and archive. Actual Site publication remains a separate provider operation.

quietGuards: Four named current statuses before input, after input, after single SH|NB acquisition, and every0.5seconds during child work.
terminalRule: Require terminal tool result and cleanup.complete=true; a failed or absent terminal receipt is not an idle ACK.
